en.name: Arlecchino
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Start by choosing a player: they're poisoned & register as evil. if they nominate & not an Archon, they die & you act twice at night.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Start by choosing a player: they're poisoned & register as evil. if they nominate & not an Archon, they die & you act twice at night.

en.flavor: Justice, wealth, ambition - mere pawns in the games played beneath the moonlit Seine. Join the waltz, and witness mine grand deception.
en.firstNightReminder: Wake Arlecchino and points a player, and place a "Poisoned" and "Register as evil" marker to player . Then put Arlecchino to sleep.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake up the Arlecchino. The Arlecchino points to a player and kills that player. The player dies, and a "Dead" token is placed next to their character token. If the player you choose on your first night nominate and not an Archon,The player dies, and a "Dead" token is placed next to their character token. Then, point to two players instead. Put the Arlecchino back to sleep.
